sql: CREATE TABLE edge_agg(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nv,SUM(v) AS s,MIN(v) AS lo,MAX(v) AS hi,AVG(v) AS a FROM edge_agg
SELECT v,COUNT(*) AS n FROM edge_agg GROUP BY v
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS n,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS s,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS a FROM edge_agg
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE v IS NULL) AS n,SUM(v) FILTER(WHERE v>2) AS s FROM edge_agg
SELECT v,COUNT(*) AS n FROM edge_agg GROUP BY v HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST
